'Which day had the water level closest to the painted mark?' and 'Why are rational numbers more useful here than integers alone?' with no scenario
widgets.root: Root cause (all lessons): the practice-studio builder keeps each exit-ticket/connect.check follow-up question but drops the shared `scenario` that the questions depend on, so the stem reaches the student with no givens. Fix once in the builder (scripts/generate-practice-studios.mjs mastery assembly): prefix every follow-up stem with the scenario, or render the scenario as a passage above the item. The boat-ramp scenario (painted mark = 0, readings +0.75, −1.25, −0.5, +1.5 ft) is absent, so 'the painted mark' and 'here' are undefined. 5.2 also asks about distance from 0, a 7-3 idea.
widgets.replacement: 5.2 stem: 'At the Miller Lake boat ramp the painted mark counts as 0 (above it positive, below it negative). Last week the readings were Monday +0.75 ft, Tuesday −1.25 ft, Wednesday −0.5 ft, Thursday +1.5 ft. Which day's reading is between −2 and −1 on the number line?' choices the four days, key Tuesday. 5.3 stem: same scenario, 'Why are rational numbers more useful here than integers alone?' choices unchanged.
